items.title: Stock picks of the week: 5 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 31%
items.description: When the Indian market will start to recover in any real sense is still an open question. But one positive is that the broader market indices have been able to weather the storm called the US-Iran war much better than most expected. This suggests that the probability and possibility of a sharp correction is low. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.
